name: NexTile
description:
Automatic largest-tile splitting, an adaptive transparent panel, centered numbered workspaces and in-panel Super-key search with native GNOME results. Controls live in Quick Settings.

Optional terminal transparency changes the GNOME Terminal GTK 3 style. The adaptive panel samples a narrow screen strip in memory; no images are saved or sent.

Activating a search result that supplies text (such as a character) copies that text to the clipboard. NexTile never reads the clipboard.
